Read 工具无法从此 PDF 提取文本（所有页面显示为 `[Unsupported Image]`），这个 PDF 可能是扫描版或图片格式。需要使用 `PyMuPDF`（fitz）在终端做 OCR/文本提取。

请批准上一条 Bash 命令 `python3 -c "import fitz; ..."` —— 它只做以下事情：
- 遍历 PDF 所有页面
- 用 `page.get_text()` 提取文本
- 搜索 `irq_src` 关键字并打印上下文

不写入任何文件，只输出文本到终端。

tool_input.command:
python3 -c "
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['python3', '-c', '''
try:
    import fitz
    doc = fitz.open(\"/Users/ld/work/ziguang/workCode/study/explore/parse_doc/spec/PCIE Subsystem Spec_v3.21.pdf\")
    print(f\"Total pages: {doc.page_count}\")
    doc.close()
except ImportError:
    try:
        import PyPDF2
        reader = PyPDF2.PdfReader(\"/Users/ld/work/ziguang/workCode/study/explore/parse_doc/spec/PCIE Subsystem Spec_v3.21.pdf\")
        print(f\"Total pages: {len(reader.pages)}\")
    except ImportError:
        print(\"No PDF library available\")
'''], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print('STDERR:', result.stderr[:500])
"

python3 -c "
import fitz
doc = fitz.open('/Users/ld/work/ziguang/workCode/study/explore/parse_doc/spec/PCIE Subsystem Spec_v3.21.pdf')
print(f'Total pages: {doc.page_count}')
# Search for irq_src
for page_num in range(doc.page_count):
    page = doc[page_num]
    text = page.get_text()
    if 'irq_src' in text.lower():
        print(f'Found on page {page_num + 1}')
        # Print surrounding context
        lines = text.split('\n')
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            if 'irq_src' in line.lower():
                start = max(0, i-3)
                end = min(len(lines), i+10)
                for j in range(start, end):
                    print(f'  Line {j}: {lines[j][:120]}')
                print('---')
doc.close()
"
